parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: CloudCode
parameters.description:
The code of the cloud service provider. Valid values:

- qcloud: Tencent Cloud.

- aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.

- hcloud: Huawei Cloud.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data source. The ID is an MD5 hash that is calculated based on the values of other parameters. You can call the [DescribeDataSourceInstance](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CDescribeDataSourceInstance) operation to obtain the data source ID.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the data source.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceParams
parameters.description: The parameters of the data source, in a JSON array format.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceRemark
parameters.description: The description of the data source.

parameters.name: DataSourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- ckafka: Tencent Cloud CKafka.

- obs: Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS).

- wafApi: the API used to download attack logs from Tencent Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of the threat analysis feature is located. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China.
